truths.truth: `locate` carries a replay-stop arm that fires only on no `--rerun` plus a FIRST LINE reading exactly `PLAN COMPLETE` for EVERY plan, names the phase, each report path read and both remedies, and stops before git_guard / phase_start / any dispatch - sitting BELOW the executed/complete arm
truths.evidence: cadence-core/workflows/execute.md:40-68 is the arm ('No `--rerun` token ... AND for EVERY plan file the phase lists, `<plandir>/reports/plan-<k>.md` exists and its FIRST LINE reads exactly `PLAN COMPLETE` -> stop: ...'), naming '(<name each report path you read>)', '/cad-undo <N> first, then /cad-execute <N>' and '/cad-execute <N> --rerun', closing 'Stop HERE, before `git_guard`: before the protected-branch guard, before the `phase_start` trace anchor, and before any executor dispatch.' Ordering is real, not just asserted: `<step name="locate">` is line 13, `<step name="git_guard">` line 107, and the only `trace append --phase <N> ... --event phase_start` is execute.md:147, inside git_guard. The arm is second, after the executed/complete arm at execute.md:31-39. Its two load-bearing cross-references check out: `<report_file>` in skills/cad-executor-contract/SKILL.md:198-239 derives the same `<plandir>/reports/plan-<k>.md` and rotates the OLD report to `plan-<k>.<n>.md` (so the current run's report is always the un-suffixed name the arm reads), and bin/planning/status.mjs:287-291 does omit `plans` for a lone PLAN.md, so the absent-key case the arm spells out is real and the zero-plan vacuous case is already taken by the `unplanned` arm at execute.md:29. Mutation-checked: deleting the arm from a scratch copy makes `EXP-03: execute.md refuses a phase whose every plan already reports complete` fail while #195 still passes.

human_checks.name: Run /cad-execute <N> against a phase whose PLAN-1 has a reports/plan-1.md reading PLAN COMPLETE on its first line and whose PLAN-2 has no report, then read .planning/trace.jsonl for that run
human_checks.expected: The run reaches the dispatch and shows exactly one executor dispatch for that run, keyed to plan 2 - plan 1 is not re-dispatched
human_checks.why_human: Out-of-reach resource, not an unexercised probe: the deliverable is prose an orchestrator obeys, so the only way to observe the dispatch count is the interactive /cad-execute command spawning real cad-executor subagents, which a verifier subagent cannot invoke and which would append real lifecycle events to .planning/trace.jsonl and buy a dispatch. Everything checkable without a live run is already verified (truths 1-4).

human_checks.name: Run /cad-execute <N> against the spike's probe shape - every task committed, reports/plan-<k>.md on disk for every plan, no SUMMARY.md - and check .planning/trace.jsonl for that run
human_checks.expected: The run stops inside locate naming the phase, each report path and both remedies, with no dispatch event and no phase_start line appended for that run, and no protected-branch question asked
human_checks.why_human: Same reason: only a live /cad-execute exercises whether the orchestrator obeys the arm, and running it spends a session against a real phase and writes to the trace record. Code inspection has already settled that the arm exists, triggers correctly and is ordered ahead of git_guard, the phase_start append and every dispatch site.
